scenes.title: 2004 Regensburg 3-Scan Trial: 90 Days of 3-Ball Juggling Expands Visual-Motion Area hMT+/V5 — 90 Idle Days Shrinks It Back!
scenes.era: 2004, Department of Neurology, University of Regensburg, Germany

layout.description: Sunlit high-key 2004 German university neurology gallery where a beginner-turned-juggler holds a crisp **3-ball cascade arc in mid-air** beside a **60-Second Qualification Stopwatch** and an illuminated **3-Scan Longitudinal MRI Timeline Board**: **Scan 1 Baseline (Flat) -> Scan 2 Month-3 Juggling Peak (Warm Bilateral hMT+/V5 Expansion!) -> Scan 3 Month-6 Zero Practice (Partial Recession — 'Use It or Lose It'!)**.

props.period_detail: stages the exact behavioral mastery criterion from Nature 2004

props.name: T1 -> T2 (+hMT+/V5 Expansion) -> T3 (Idle Washout) 3-Scan MRI Board

actions.verb_sequence: drops balls on Day 1 (Scan 1) -> masters a smooth 60-second 3-ball cascade at Month 3 as bilateral hMT+/V5 & parietal gray matter expand on Scan 2 -> sets balls on the shelf for 90 idle days -> Scan 3 shows partial gray-matter recession!

reactions.reaction: marvels that their VISUAL motion radar — not just finger muscles — grew in 90 days
document reversible structural plasticity in ordinary healthy adults

scenes.recognition_hook: Teach complete beginners to juggle three balls for sixty seconds and MRI catches visual-motion gray matter expanding in ninety days — forbid practice for the next ninety days and watch it shrink halfway back!
